description: Samuele Zilio and colleagues at Eurac Research publish spatial estimates of renewable energy potential for Oberland, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Lombardia, the Porto metropolitan area and Alba County. The analysis covers onshore wind and four photovoltaic configurations: agricultural, ground-mounted, residential-rooftop and non-residential-rooftop deployment. Native documentation identifies municipal-level GeoPackage results and technology-specific text descriptions. Global land-cover and terrain sources are combined with regional data where available. This is a derived potential-estimation dataset for regional energy planning, not a census of installed generation. Zenodo provides free open access under the Open Database Licence (ODbL 1.0). Coverage is the five European pilot regions; exact estimation year and every spatial constraint are not established here. The related PLANtoACT energy-balance and hourly-profile resources have different roles. A limitation is that underlying values and accuracy were not checked. No spatial features, archives or documentation-file bodies were downloaded.
